title: Fulgurites in Giza iron veins as evidence of high-voltage current
summary: Jeffrey tells of Fulgurites in Giza iron veins as evidence of high-voltage current, about ancient at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In these iron ore veins, we have samples that contain fulgurites, which is evidence of high-voltage electric current distribution through these iron veins.

plain: On Jesse Michels's podcast, a researcher called Jeffrey says that iron ore veins at the Giza Plateau in Egypt, where the great pyramids stand, contain fulgurites. These are glassy traces left when lightning or another strong electric current melts rock. He says they show that high-voltage electricity once ran through those veins, which would mean the site carried some kind of electrical energy.
